candidates.title: Exact-statement and proof-evidence registry
candidates.target: Turn the existing documentary gate into a small typed registry that binds an imported claim to exact revision, manuscript, declaration, assumptions, quantifiers, observable, limits, conclusion and evidence level.
candidates.priorGap: The current 17 controls compare agent-written scope strings. They do not establish semantic equivalence or enforce a separate executable proof receipt. The earlier CAT(0) parser defect and human-review provenance label show why revisions and evidence transitions need explicit records.

candidates.whyNowFeasible: Five scoped records, 17 positive/negative/abstention controls, a corrected complete inventory and consolidated claim IDs already exist. No new mathematical theorem or broad literature collection is needed.
requiredAssumptions: The registry is documentary infrastructure, not a semantic proof checker.
Reviewer kind and reading depth are explicit; agent review never becomes human review by relabeling.
Metadata match, statement-fidelity review, proof execution and experiment validation are distinct evidence levels.
A proof receipt names the exact declaration, source hash, toolchain/dependency pins, command, exit status, log and observed axiom check.
Unknown or missing evidence causes abstention; a scope/version mismatch is not a theorem disproof.
candidates.decisiveFalsifier: A control that assigns proof-verified status without an execution receipt, transfers family365 nonuniqueness coverage to headline uniqueness, silently bridges family342 versions, or promotes the family215 finite-correlation statement to a continuum claim must fail admission. One accepted forbidden promotion invalidates the implementation.
candidates.deliverable: Versioned claim/evidence schema, validator, append-only provenance records, reproducible receipts and discriminating fixtures integrated with the existing graph. Preserve prior math-crosswalk files.
controls: Positive exact documentary match remains metadata-only.
Wrong paper/version/declaration/quantifier and unsupported reviewer kind are rejected.
Independent skeptic supplies at least one fixture unseen by the implementer.
candidates.resourceEstimate: One bounded implementation block of roughly 2–4 agent-hours, CPU only; no corpus-wide proof builds. Refine in planning1.
candidates.stopRule: Stop after the declared fixture set and independent review; unsupported semantic or build questions remain pending. Do not expand to auditing all manuscripts.
candidates.independentReview: Skeptic freezes adversarial evidence transitions before implementation; methods reviewer checks proof-receipt semantics.

classification.establishedResult: Prior census, exact scope distinctions and 17 documentary controls were executed and recorded.
classification.derivedConjecture: No new physical or mathematical conjecture proposed; the expected engineering benefit is fewer unsupported evidence promotions.
classification.solvableFiniteTask: A finite schema/validator/receipt workflow with bounded fixtures.
classification.openGrandChallenge: Yang–Mills continuum existence/mass gap, source-free energy and general inverse uniqueness remain outside this task.
